groups.activity: wait for Operation: Plague Star to go live

live.text: available only while the event is running

rows.label: Operation: Plague Star
rows.note: the shop closes with the event; prior gaps between reruns have run 1-2 years

conditions: Untradeable: no plat shortcut, no buying it from another player, and no way to catch up after the event ends.

groups.meta: no daily cap; standing persists between events

rows.label: Advanced bounty
rows.note: Lvl 55-65, 3,200 standing, +75 drone bonus; needs an Eidolon Phylaxis and Infested Catalyst per player

rows.label: Steel Path bounty
rows.note: Lvl 100-110, 3,800 standing, +100 drone bonus; same Phylaxis/Catalyst requirement
rows.alt: the base Plague Star bounty needs neither item

conditions: Advanced and Steel Path each consume one Eidolon Phylaxis and one Infested Catalyst per run per player; a squad missing either on one member won't start the bounty.
Do not shoot the Infested spawn pods in stage 4: they feed the Hemocyte kill counter, and killing them slows the run.
bonuses: Keeping the escort drone above 80% health during stage 3 is the entire bonus-standing mechanic; Volt, Wisp, or a pre-placed Nova Wormhole speed it up.
Three Advanced runs (3,275 standing net each) covers the 8,000-standing floor with change.

disclosures.title: rank ladder
disclosures.body: Rank 1 Collaborator: 1,000 standing, 10 Grokdrul, 5,000cr. Rank 2 Defender: 2,000 standing, 10 Iradite, 10,000cr. Rank 3 Champion: 3,000 standing, 10 Nistlepod, 20,000cr. Each rank-up grants one free item of that rank.

groups.activity: buy the Strike and Grip blueprints

rows.label: Plague Bokwin Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: Seekalla (Ostron, Hok): -4 damage / 1.000 speed, the community's speed-over-damage pick

conditions: The strike's grip handedness decides the weapon class: one-handed makes a Rapier (2.5m), two-handed makes a Polearm (3.0m) with a 1.08x damage multiplier. Most people build the Polearm.

disclosures.title: grip alternatives
disclosures.body: Ostron-vendor grips read faster in the current meta: Seekalla for two-handed, Peye for one-handed, both -4 damage / 1.000 speed, the fastest in their class. Reserve Shtung (+28 damage) for an Exodia Contagion build where base damage matters more than swing speed.

groups.activity: buy the Vargeet II Jai link

rows.label: Vargeet II Jai Blueprint
rows.note: +14% crit, -8% status, +speed; near-unanimous Zaw link pick
rows.alt: Ekwana II Jai for a status/Melee Influence build

conditions: Reaching Ostron Trusted is a separate, larger standing grind on top of Operational Supply; if you've already Zaw-farmed to Trusted for another weapon this is free.

rows.label: Plague Kripath Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 1,600 Nano Spores, 700 Plastids, 10 Tear Azurite, 60 Pyrotic Alloy

rows.label: Plague Bokwin Grip
rows.note: 5,000cr, 20 Grokdrul, 15 Fish Scales, 30 Coprite Alloy, 1,100 Plastids

rows.label: Vargeet II Jai Link
rows.note: 5,000cr, 5 Maprico, 20 Fersteel Alloy, 5 Kuaka Spinal Claw, 5 Mortus Horn

rows.label: gild at rank 30
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing; resets to rank 0

conditions: Mastery is tied to the Strike only, and only the first gilded Kripath counts, so extra blueprints are optional.
Full stats unlock at rank 30 whether or not you gild; gilding buys mastery, a polarity, the custom name and Exodia arcane slots.
bonuses: Buy the two Cetus Wisps from Nakak for 750 standing + 1,500cr each instead of hunting them on the Plains.

disclosures.title: build direction
disclosures.body: Exodia Contagion on a Kripath polearm, especially on Mirage whose clones multiply the projectiles, is the build people still show off; regular Primes and Incarnons out-stat a Zaw on raw numbers now.
